pm_exper_user_2994_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some fun ways to plan themed get-togethers with friends that can make watching a major sporting event feel more exciting and memorable?
pm_exper_user_2994_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) You could host a backyard BBQ with your grill going, big-screen cricket match on in the yard, and snacks inspired by the teams playing—think paneer tikka sliders for India matches or Aussie meat pies for an Australia game. Add in some friendly prediction cards or mini cricket challenges at halftime, and y’all will have a spirited, photo-worthy gathering.
(b) You could host a backyard BBQ with your grill going, big-screen Bollywood movie night under the stars, and snacks that blend Texas BBQ with Indian street food—think brisket samosas or masala corn on the cob. Add a filmi sing-along contest during intermission, and y’all will have a spirited, photo-worthy gathering.
(c) You could host a backyard BBQ with your grill going, big-screen movie marathon running outside, and snacks inspired by the films—think popcorn bars for classic comedies or spicy fusion tacos for action flicks. Add in some comfy blankets and a best-quote contest, and y’all will have a spirited, photo-worthy gathering.
(d) You could host a backyard BBQ with your grill going, big-screen viewing of the game set up outside, and snacks inspired by the teams playing. Add in some friendly prediction games or fun halftime activities, and everyone will have a spirited, photo-worthy gathering.
